_notes: Xiaomi 15T Pro uses MediaTek, not Qualcomm — significantly different low-level recovery path. EDL does NOT apply; the MTK equivalent is BROM mode. MiFlash does NOT flash MTK — use SP Flash Tool. The exploit tool landscape is also different: mtkclient covers older Dimensity chips but Dimensity 9400+ coverage needs verification. UFS speeds observed through adb dd: 823 write / 1024 read MB/s — typical for MediaTek controllers through encrypted f2fs (slower than Qualcomm equivalents under the same measurement method).
